name: What challenges are common when replacing flooring in an older Bay Area home?

mainEntity.name: What challenges are common when replacing flooring in an older Bay Area home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Older Bay Area homes often present unique challenges during flooring replacement. These can include uneven subfloors, which require leveling before new installation; asbestos-containing materials in existing flooring (like old vinyl tiles or adhesives) that necessitate professional abatement; and varying floor heights between rooms. Additionally, original trim or baseboards may need careful removal or replacement to accommodate new flooring thickness. Our team is experienced in addressing these specific issues common to the region's older housing stock.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common challenges in older Bay Area homes include uneven subfloors, potential asbestos, and differing floor heights, all of which require experienced handling.
